title: ContactRoute
description: A specific, sourced, and verified path by which a message may be delivered to a Person. A contact route requires source provenance and a verification timestamp before it may be used. No contact route may be used without a known origin — no inferred or scraped private addresses.

route_type.description: Channel classification. Determines which automation tier is allowed to use this route.

contact_person_ref.description: Opaque encrypted-field reference for the intermediary name.

contact_person_role.description: Role of the intermediary (e.g. publicist, manager, EA).

organization.description: Organization the contact person represents (e.g. agency name).

address_ref.description: Opaque encrypted-field reference for the contact address. Raw email and phone values never appear in this public contract.

source_ref.description: Opaque provenance reference. Required — no sourceless routes.

verified_at.description: When this route was last verified as active. Null = unverified, may not be used for automated outreach.

preferred.description: Whether this is the preferred route for this person in the current booking context.

permission_status.description: Current permission state of this route. opted_out is terminal and cannot be overridden.

notes_ref.description: Opaque encrypted-field reference for private route notes.
